messages:
maria.g: quick check — courier just asked for a strict dropoff window for the Summit Satellite demo kits. can we lock a 30m window?

davidh: we put 10:30-11:00 on the venue runbook but that was tentative. 30m window sounds good. who will meet courier?

jess: i'll be on-site. planning to arrive 9:45 to set up the mini-booth and test streaming. can meet courier.

leo: courier prefers AM deliveries. do we have the pickup tracking + PO# so they can attach to the manifest?

maria.g: PO# RED-877-SAT. tracker link: https://shipping.example/track/RED877 (courier sent that). ops-bot, any restrictions from venue on large pallets?

ops-bot: venue-rule: no pallets delivered before 09:00. deliveries must be to Loading Dock B (dock code: LD-B). Contact: Tanya Hall (tanya@venue.com).

samira: note on swag — we have 1x pallet of stickers (5k), 2x totes (800), 1x plush mascot (100). does the courier need itemized manifest? i'll paste the manifest in case:
```
- SKU RED-STK-01: 5000 stickers (box packs)
- SKU RED-TOTE-02: 800 totes (50 per box)
- SKU RED-MSK-PL: 100 mascots (fragile)
- Demo racks: 4 crates (electronics, labelled FRAGILE)
```

jess: please FLAG the mascots as fragile and put foam between crates. venue has limited storage room; we'll need direct handoff to the demo team.

davidh: on speaking submissions — we have a last-minute slot on the satellite stage (12:30). can we prep a 10-min lightning about routing/leadflow? who can draft?

maria.g: i'll draft a quick 6-slide deck focusing on inbound lead routing + post-demo follow-up. need one slide with the QR + UTM. can someone confirm the QR landing is live?

leo: QR route: https://redwood.ai/summit-satellite?utm_source=satellite&utm_campaign=summer23 — it's live on staging, pushing to prod now. Samira can you confirm the endpoint captures 'venue' tag for routing?

samira: yes — endpoint has 'venue' param. we will tag leads as source:satellite and venue:SummitSouth. I'll also add campaign:summer23.

maria.g: perfect. jess, can you bring the handheld scanner and power strip? we need to scan badge QR + attach lead tags to hubs.

jess: i've got handheld scanner + spare battery pack + multi-USB power strip. also bringing a small label printer. what label format are we using?

samira: use 2-line label: NAME | EMAIL on top line, then TAGS on second line (comma-separated). e.g.,
```
Maya Ortiz | maya@company.com
source:satellite,venue:SummitSouth,interest:embeddings
```

maria.g: routing plan: all scanned leads -> realtime webhook to /leads/inbound -> triage rules: if interest:enterprise then assign to AE queue, else marketing-nurture. Can we test it before the talk?

leo: i'll run a dry run at 11:15 with a fake badge. davidh — can you be AE fallback for the dry run?

davidh: yep i'll monitor the AE queue during the dry run.

ops-bot: pickup scheduled by CourierCo at 08:15. ETA to venue: 10:45. Reminder: label printer requires 110V adapter for dock power.

maria.g: thanks — last items: who handles on-site returns of leftover swag? venue charges storage after 5pm. suggest we pack leftover totes/stickers back into courier crate and have them pick up at 17:30. agree?

jess: agreed. i'll inventory at teardown and prepare crate for 17:30 pickup.

samira: i'll add a tag to the manifest: return-pickup: 2024-06-15T17:30Z.

maria.g: awesome. if nobody objects, i'll pin this thread and add checklist to the shared runbook. thanks all :thumbsup:
